title: GTA 6 Eve: What's the Best GTA of All Time?
description: As we approach the massive 2026 launch of GTA 6, Eurogamer kicks off its GTA Week by asking the ultimate question: what is the best GTA game ever made?
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Ultimate Question Ahead of the GTA 6 Launch

As we teeter on the brink of what is undoubtedly gaming's biggest launch of 2026—and perhaps even the entire decade—excitement is reaching a fever pitch. Countless questions are swirling within the community: which GTA 6 cars will have the best engine roars? How infectious can that Justice theme song really be? While the definitive answers will arrive in due time, renowned gaming outlet Eurogamer has turned its attention to the past and present as part of its special GTA Week.

Bringing back their irregular discussion series, The Big Question, the outlet has posed a topic that every fan has debated at some point: what's the best GTA?

## Nostalgia, Evolution, and Cultural Impact

Every single entry in Rockstar's legendary franchise has left an indelible mark on the gaming landscape. As fans crank up iconic tunes like those of Phil Collins and gear up for the upcoming journey into the next evolution of the series, looking back at the predecessor titles offers a fascinating perspective on how far open-world gaming has come.

- **Technological Leaps:** Each major release redefined hardware limits, pushing open-world immersion to new heights.
- **Soundtracks and Atmosphere:** From unforgettable radio stations to distinct stylistic choices, the music has always defined the era.
- **Player Connection:** Individual favorites often depend on which title introduced players to the chaotic freedom of the franchise.

## Setting the Stage for 2026

Discussions surrounding car sounds, musical scores, and the sheer scale of the upcoming 2026 release highlight just how much anticipation surrounds the franchise. Eurogamer's timely question serves as a wonderful celebration of the series' history while the world eagerly awaits the next monumental chapter.

## Editor's Take

As we stand on the threshold of GTA 6 in 2026, revisiting the question of the best GTA game reminds us of Rockstar's consistent ability to shape the medium. Whether your personal favorite is a nostalgic classic or a later masterpiece, the franchise's legacy is unmatched, making this community-wide reflection an essential part of the countdown to launch.
